column2: What is a record’s template (🧩 Template)?
column3: The boxes you note down for each kind of record (baptism: date, child, born on, father, mother, godfather, godmother, priest, signatures; and also birth, marriage, death, burial, notarial deed, act of notoriety, census, military register). In the 📜 Transcription workshop, “Spot” step: the “🧩 Template” tab next to “What the app found”. “🧭 Spot” fills in the boxes (in green, to be checked); type in a box to correct it, Enter or ✓ marks it as checked: Spot never touches a box you checked or wrote yourself again. A click on “l. 3” (or “page 2, l. 3”) shows the passage. With “To be specified”, the tab suggests the guessed kind. The template’s ⋯ menu: “Fill-in-the-blanks text (as before)” if you prefer the old template, “Paste the fill-in-the-blanks text”, “Fill in again”.

column2: How do I add my own boxes to a template, and get a spreadsheet of records?
column3: “✓ Add to the family tree” takes the boxes of the 🧩 Template that you checked (✓) or wrote: they come before what the app had guessed, and the preview says so before you accept. In a record: “＋ Add a box” (for example “Godfather’s occupation”); × removes it. For a whole kind of record: the template’s ⋯ menu → “🧩 My templates…”: hide a ready-made box or add your own (also for “Letter” and “Other”, which have no boxes to start with). ⋯ menu → “⤓ Spreadsheet of all … records”: one row per record of this kind, one column per box (a parish index). When printing and in PDF, “🧩 Template” adds the table of boxes.
